name: Lycanthrope
description: Race Change - You are a Lycanthrope, a half-wolf who can assume Werewolf form at will. The more you tap into your transformation, the more your physical stats and instincts, including animalistic ones, augment. As a regular Lycanthrope, you cannot spread lycanthropy. You also communicate better with Beasts and gain greater affinity for Changer powers, increasing their potency and efficiency.
